questions.def: Subjunctive uses the base form of the verb after 'suggest'.
questions.question: I suggest that he ___ to the doctor.

questions.def: Subjunctive uses the base form 'be' after 'important'.
questions.question: It is important that she ___ on time.

questions.def: 'Demand' triggers the subjunctive using the base form 'be'.
questions.question: The teacher demands that every student ___ on time.

questions.def: 'Insisted' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: The boss insisted that I ___ the report.

questions.def: 'Were' is used for wishes in the subjunctive.
questions.question: I wish I ___ taller.

questions.def: 'Were' is used after 'if' for hypothetical situations.
questions.question: If I was you, I would go to the party.

questions.def: 'Suggest' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: She suggests that he ___ early today.

questions.def: 'Vital' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: It is vital that he ___ the truth.

questions.def: 'Asked' can trigger the subjunctive using the base form 'be'.
questions.question: She asked that he ___ quiet.

questions.def: 'Require' triggers the subjunctive using the base form.
questions.question: The school requires that each student ___ a uniform.

questions.def: 'Recommend' needs the base form of the verb.
questions.question: I recommend that he ___ a break.

questions.def: 'Had' is used in 'if only' sentences for regrets.
questions.question: If only I ___ more time.

questions.def: 'Urge' triggers the subjunctive using the base form.
questions.question: I urge that she ___ harder for the exam.

questions.def: 'Crucial' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: It is crucial that she ___ the truth.

questions.def: 'Propose' takes the subjunctive, so 'hold' is correct.
questions.question: They propose that we ___ a meeting.

questions.def: 'Had moved' expresses a past wish (regret).
questions.question: I wish I ___ to a new city.

questions.def: 'Essential' triggers the subjunctive using the base form 'be'.
questions.question: It is essential that he ___ here.

questions.def: 'Requests' takes the subjunctive form 'call'.
questions.question: She requests that he ___ her.

questions.def: 'Insist' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: He insists that she ___ until the end.

questions.def: 'Suggest' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: I suggest that she ___ more water.

questions.def: 'Were' is used for hypothetical situations.
questions.question: If I ___ rich, I would travel.

questions.def: 'Advise' triggers the subjunctive using the base form.
questions.question: The doctor advises that he ___ for a week.

questions.def: 'Imperative' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: It is imperative that he ___ on time.

questions.def: 'Propose' requires the subjunctive form 'take'.
questions.question: I propose that we ___ a vote.

questions.def: After 'suggest,' use the base form of the verb in the subjunctive.
questions.question: I suggest that he ___ to the doctor.

questions.def: After 'important,' use the base form of the verb in the subjunctive.
questions.question: It is important that she ___ on time.

questions.def: 'Wish' uses 'were' for unreal situations, not 'was'.
questions.question: I wish I was taller so I could reach that shelf.

questions.def: 'Demand' needs the base form of 'be' in the subjunctive.
questions.question: I demand that he ___ (be) present at the meeting.

questions.def: 'Were' is used for hypothetical situations with 'if'.
questions.question: If I ___ you, I would take the job.

questions.def: 'Necessary' requires the base form of the verb.
questions.question: It is necessary that she ___ the application form.
